derived_cache.meaning: Unmodified numeric columns A/B after header row. Signed voltages and stored current values preserved. No clipping, fitting, filtering, resampling, or synthetic points.
derived_cache.parser: Python zipfile and xml.etree.ElementTree; workbook relationships resolve worksheet names; first row is header; A/B numeric columns are voltage/current.

scope_limits: 1T1R cycles 1-3 preserved but excluded from primary normal-operation fitting/evaluation per advisor.
Matching bare-R numeric sheet identifiers allow explicit pairing; chronological/device identity beyond sheet naming needs source provenance.
Bare-R sheets are 22 labels among 1-24; missing labels are preserved rather than silently renumbered.
All workbooks originate from current local Git HEAD, not independently content-matched to Zenodo original release.
1R and 1T1M share nominal stack/geometry in Zhu Nature Methods; SI Fig.2 places them in different chip regions, so these are different physical cells.

bare_1r_numerical_audit.electrical_current_sign: All 8888 bare-R stored currents are nonnegative, including negative-voltage RESET. Treat stored current as magnitude; physical signed current in passive convention requires sign(V)*abs(I).

same_identifier_state_compatibility.method: Initial RESET resistance at -0.05V divided by preceding same-identifier SET return resistance at +0.05V; all SET readout points used here are below compliance.
same_identifier_state_compatibility.limit: Near agreement supports SET-to-RESET continuity within most indexed pairs; cannot establish chronological order across sheets or absence of wait/relaxation.

bare_1r_numerical_audit.voltage_column_interpretation: Exactly regular nominal ramps coexist with a nearly 1mA SET ceiling even at 5V; these are consistent with a command-voltage axis and incompatible with simultaneously treating 5V as the hard-state internal voltage. Headers alone do not certify command versus independently measured voltage. Preserve nominal command as model input and expose separately solved actual voltage.
bare_1r_numerical_audit.resistance_interpretation: Approximately 96ohm is supported by these raw RESET low-voltage measurements and independent below-compliance SET return readout, unlike the particular SI Fig.6 example (~1kohm); do not identify this workbook as that exact sample without mapping.
bare_1r_numerical_audit.initial_reset_point_diagnostic: The -0.025V point is often anomalously suppressed relative to the linear -0.05 to -0.2V branch. This may reflect settling/ranging but cause is unverified; score both inclusion and exclusion as sensitivity, and do not fit this single point as a material resistance.
bare_1r_numerical_audit.forming_vs_repeated_set: All 22 positive sweeps have >0.5mA crossing between 2.5 and 2.8V and low initial current. Sheet labels and electrical trace alone cannot establish whether they are virgin forming across cells, repeated high-threshold SET on one cell, or a selected subset. Original model calls them forming; retain that as legacy annotation, not verified metadata. Do not equate a measured onset voltage to a state-independent internal cessation threshold. SI Fig.6 reports later SET~0.59V for its own example, therefore it cannot be silently substituted for the workbook onset.

recommended_scoring.instrument_response: Score full predicted nominal-voltage/current output, including compliance plateau, using actual-voltage circuit closure. Exclude V=0 from log current RMSE, retain raw values and report zero-voltage offsets separately. Equal-weight branches and sweeps to avoid plateau domination.
recommended_scoring.uncensored_material_response: Separately score SET samples with measured |I| <0.995mA. Report mask counts and sensitivity to 0.99 and 0.999mA; never extrapolate a plateau as an uncensored 1mA material observation. RESET has no such 1mA mask.
recommended_scoring.low_signal: Report log-RMSE with explicit noise floor/censor rule and count excluded samples; use the same rule for all models. Also report low-bias R, switching voltage and endpoint ratios. A noise floor is not inferred from the positive magnitude near zero without documenting the uncertainty.
recommended_scoring.SET_low_bias_handoff: Use uncensored +0.05V return point for all22 sweeps. Higher read voltages are at compliance in many sweeps, so Vnom/I there is not physical hard-state R.
recommended_scoring.RESET_low_bias_handoff: Use forward -0.05 to -0.2V slope or individual same-voltage readouts. Report -0.025V inclusion/exclusion sensitivity.
recommended_scoring.primary_1t1r: Keep all raw53 pairs but primary normal-operation metrics use cycles4-53. Do not silently use cycles1-3 in the scored training target.
